A '''B1 battle droid''' was stationed on the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous's]] [[Grievous's Munificent-class star frigate (suspected Confederate space)/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] and participated in the [[Mission to suspected Confederate space/Legends|ambush]] on [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] in Separatist space around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was ordered to move the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]] into attack position. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], however, escaped with the help of Republic reinforcements and, adding insult to injury, caused the cruisers to collide. The droid then awkwardly reported their failure to Grievous, who responded by growling at the droid and smacking its head off.

==Behind the scenes==
This [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] is to the left of General Grievous, but earlier in the scene that place was occupied by an [[OOM pilot battle droid/Legends|OOM pilot battle droid]]. This article assumes they are two different droids and this B1 took the OOM unit's place off screen.
